hashDag.candidateDecisionRowSetRecipe: SHA-256 of canonical recursively key-sorted UTF-8/LF JSON wrapper {schemaVersion:navigation-candidate-decision-row-set-v1,protocolVersion,candidateId,decisionRows}; exactly that candidate's 21 rows sorted by numeric familyNumber then decisionId; no digest field
hashDag.jsonRecipe: recursively lexically sort object keys, preserve contract-declared array order, strict UTF-8, exactly one LF
